sections.heading: 1. Heel slide
lines: ① Lying down, slide your heel towards your bottom.
② Bend as far as comfortable, hold 5 sec.
③ Slowly straighten, 10 reps, 3 times a day.
④ Resting? Elevate the leg for swelling.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: A sharp jump in pain: call your surgeon.

slides.heading: Contact your surgeon or GP if

caption:
New knee? Here's roughly what the first 12 weeks look like. Weeks 0 to 2 are gentle bending and straightening plus short, frequent walks. Weeks 2 to 6 build the bend and work on getting the knee fully straight. From around week 6, thigh and hip strength usually take centre stage.

Everyone's timeline differs. Swelling and stiffness can linger for months, and many people keep improving for a year or more.

Call your surgeon or GP about wound redness or discharge, fever, or calf pain or swelling. Sudden shortness of breath needs urgent care, so call 000. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios progress rehab in line with your surgeon's guidelines. Book online via the link in bio.
